title_en: Why aren't you sleeping, pretty love

lines.cyr: - Што не спиеш, лично либе цел' ноќ крај мене,
lines.lat: - Što ne spieš, lično libe cel' noḱ kraj mene,
lines.en: - Why aren't you sleeping, pretty love, whole night next to me,

lines.cyr: дали постела ти, либе, тврда под тебе?
lines.lat: dali postela ti, libe, tvrda pod tebe?
lines.en: is the bed, love, too hard for you?

lines.cyr: Во една постела, либе, двајца лежиме,
lines.lat: Vo edna postela, libe, dvajca ležime,
lines.en: In one bed, love, we both sleep,

lines.cyr: едно друго еднаш, либе, не целиваме.
lines.lat: edno drugo ednaš, libe, ne celivame.
lines.en: each other, not even once, love, we kiss.

lines.cyr: - Постела ми мека, либе, како душава,

my chest is pressed with a limestone.
